_template: THE YOUNGSTER — Task Record Template v1.0
_instructions: Create one record per distinct task. Use subtask support for complex tasks.
title: [Action-oriented task name: VERB + OBJECT]
description: [Full context: what needs to be done, why, what done looks like]
status: [backlog | ready | in_progress | waiting | blocked | in_review | completed | cancelled | deferred]
next_action: [The specific next thing that needs to happen to move this forward]
waiting_on: [What external input is needed — if status is 'waiting']
source_reference: [Quote or link that created this task]
completion_evidence: [How completion was confirmed — quote or reference]

history.event: [created | status_changed | deadline_changed | reassigned | blocked | unblocked | completed]
